items.title: Drømmeuke for Vålerenga: Knuste Oilers
items.excerpt: Vålerenga slo Stavanger Oilers 4–1 på bortebane, og tok med det sin andre strake seier mot en tittelrival i eliteserien i ishockey. Torsdag ble Frisk Asker slått 5–2 i Oslo. Vålerenga leder nå serien to poeng foran Frisk Asker. Stavanger Oilers er nummer fem etter en svært skuffende sesongstart.

items.title: Spurs pick up rare Stamford Bridge win as Palmer is sent off
items.excerpt: Tottenham picked up just their second victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge in 36 years with a 2-0 victory, as the host finished with 10-men after a record card for Cole Palmer.

items.title: Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis
items.excerpt: The ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr, with whom she shares five children, announced in May that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.

items.title: 'Best performance since I arrived' - De Zerbi praises Spurs after win
items.excerpt: Tottenham manager Roberto De Zerbi describes his side's 2-0 victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge as "the best since he arrived at the club", adding the win was special given it was against their local rivals.

items.title: Hayen sacked by Burnley after just 14 games
items.excerpt: Nicky Hayen is sacked after just 14 games in charge at Burnley following a poor start to the season.
